content: Elicitation (code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp, fetched 2026-11-27): Claude Code supports form and URL modes on own-configured servers; on claude.ai connector connections with protocol revisions <= 2025-11-25 it declares bare elicitation {} (form only). The claude.com connector building guide does not list elicitation as supported on claude.ai/Desktop/mobile chat; treat as unavailable there until tested.
